others.name: Kuoh Lee
others.role: Executive vice president, chief operating officer

what: It designs and builds process equipment and modules for offshore and onshore energy projects, including floating oil production vessels.
proceeds: It expects to raise about $14.0 million after costs. Roughly $9.0 million is for project work and working capital, $3.0 million to repay some debt, and $2.0 million for engineering and general needs. It says this is not enough to fund all its needs.
risks: Offshore oil and gas spending swings sharply, which could make the company's sales and profits rise and fall a lot.
Many contracts are fixed-price, so cost overruns, delays, supply problems or customer troubles could cut profits or cause losses.
The company faces strong competition, some from larger rivals, which could force lower prices or cost it projects.
The company depends on a few large customers and projects, so losing one could seriously hurt its revenue and results.
